entropy_brackets._note: MODELLED, not measured. D-02: three brackets reported as a band. Dither probabilities/bit counts are a human-authored model of payload behaviour, confirmed at the 00-04 checkpoint. Payload entropy is exactly the quantity this gate exists to measure, and synthetic data has only the entropy this model gives it -- see 00-THRESHOLD.md 'What this threshold is not'.

bus_targets._note: PARTIALLY MODELLED. load_pct and target_fps for bus1/bus2 come from telemetry_conversation.md's measured real bus loads (bus1 ~70%/~2,900 fps, bus2 ~20%/~830 fps, combined ~3,730-4,000 fps per PROJECT.md/CLAUDE.md prose) -- NOT derivable from epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc. Direct DBC measurement (tests/test_dbc_ground_truth.py) finds only 19 of 128 messages declare GenMsgCycleTime, summing to ~1,690.67 fps; the remaining 109 messages' contribution is assumed via default_period_ms_by_ecu, not known. The combined total_fps this config assumes is therefore confirmed:false: it could land anywhere between the DBC-derivable ~1,691 fps floor and the prose-cited ~3,730-4,000 fps figure. See 00-THRESHOLD.md pre-registered known risk: at 3,730-4,000 fps the CFR's fixed 6-byte header alone costs ~179-192 kbit/s, already exceeding the 120 kbit/s pass bar before any payload byte.

bus_assignment._note: MODELLED, not measured. epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc has one BU_: node line and no per-message bus attribute at all -- nothing in this repository states which of the 128 messages rides HSCAN (bus1) versus HSCAN2 (bus2). This ECU-sender proxy is a human-authored placeholder confirmed at the 00-04 checkpoint (RESEARCH.md Open Question 1 / Assumption A4), not a DBC-derived finding. It must be surfaced as a caveat in every report this config produces.

default_period_ms_by_ecu._note: MODELLED, not measured. These are assigned seed periods for the 109 (of 128) messages that declare no GenMsgCycleTime, scaled at runtime by plan 00-05's rate model so each bus's per-ECU totals hit bus_targets.<bus>.target_fps. A uniform 100 ms (10 Hz) seed is used for every ECU pending real per-message rate knowledge -- this is a placeholder proportional weight, not a measured or claimed real rate for any individual message.

measured_basis.prose_source: telemetry_conversation.md / CLAUDE.md (bus1 ~2,900 fps + bus2 ~830 fps); NOT derivable from epbr2026_DBC_v1.0.dbc
